title: Holding Several Tire Sets — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Holding rule — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** A customer may hold any number of tire sets; there is no limit per customer. Every sales ticket of tires for one vehicle opens its own set, so a household with several vehicles, or a vehicle that received two tires on one ticket and two on a later ticket, carries several sets at once.

Each set keeps its own:

| Kept per set | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Tire line | the line and warranty class bought on that ticket |
| Install odometer | the odometer written on that set's installation work order |
| Warranty clock | counted from that set's own purchase and installation |
| Adjustment credit | credit issued on that set and usable from that set only |

Nothing is pooled across sets. How many tires may be open on one vehicle at the same time is governed by the open-tire limit per vehicle class.

**Illustration (hypothetical household):** two tires bought for one car in spring and two more for the same car in autumn are two sets; a treadwear credit issued on the spring set stays on the spring set.
